_comment: Every model file the pipeline loads, by logical name. The MLflow registry is
authoritative; 'fallback' is the local file used when the registry is unreachable
or the name was never registered, and every result records which one it got.
'sha256' pins the bytes of the fallback file and 'files' pins companion files that
must sit next to it (paths relative to the fallback's directory). A pinned file
with other bytes is reported, never silently used as the same model.
Back up / check / restore: python scripts/models/register_models.py --all,

ball_detector.note: best_fullframe fine-tuned 30 epochs at imgsz 1920 (scripts/evaluation/finetune_ball_detector.py); 0.967 vs 0.944 after DP on the 6_tiPcRYGcBtc window, 0.881 vs 0.843 raw on 369 contacts. Runs only at imgsz 1920; the 1280 model stays registered as volleystat_ball_detector

ball_detector_tiled.note: second opinion for --ball-ensemble; union recall 0.93 with the primary

pose_estimator.note: stock ultralytics weights; registered so a run records which ones

player_reid.note: Pinned frozen OSNet-x1.0/MSMT17. Install matching code/license bundle with scripts/models/install_player_reid.py; raw tracker IDs remain unchanged. Confirmed roster additions supported; no contact attribution.

event_sequence.note: four-class causal multiscale final fit (410 core clips, seed 42); fold checkpoints are the leave-one-video-out models it was selected with. Restored 2026-11-08 from the byte-identical copies in results/event_team_pose_offline_20261027_v3.

contact_spotter.note: contact_spotter_v1 final fit on the three gold videos (members, normalisation and decode constraints inside). Used by viewer uploads and --contact-spotter.

contact_author.note: Promoted 2026-11-07: all-side temporal OSNet + soft HGB. Known-contact author LOSO 470/565 (83.19%); new7 307/381 (80.58%). Human photo roster in evaluation; automatic-roster accuracy unmeasured. Final all10 fit has no held-out score.

net_sam.note: net tape/post segmentation. The fallback keeps today's behaviour (vit_h from ~/Downloads); models/sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth is a different checkpoint that was never the one being used. Register whichever should win and the ambiguity is gone — but re-run scripts/run_sam_net_detection.py if you switch, because calibration caches the result. Not copied into the registry (2.5 GB stock Meta weights; an upload through the MLflow server did not finish in 40 min): the sha256 pin identifies the file, re-download it from source_url.

spotting.note: SpottingTCN, frame-level contact detection. Superseded by contact_spotter and not loaded by the pipeline; its file was already absent on 2026-11-08.
